parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass. It is a flat rectangular surface that forms the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and other visual content. It is the primary output interface of the display.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in position and does not move relative to the base.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum. It supports the screen and provides stability on a flat surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base holds the screen upright and ensures the display remains stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move, though it may allow for slight tilt adjustments depending on design.
